topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing for the lecture by linking it to prior practicals and outlining the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Oncogenes and In Vitro Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical discovery of tumor-causing viruses, the capture of cellular proto-oncogenes, and the experimental laboratory assays used to test cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional Classification and Genetic Mechanisms of Cancer Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the main categories of cancer mutations and illustrate how oncogenic, tumor-suppressive, and dominant-negative alterations regulate pathways such as the cell cycle and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms, Types, and Multistep Progression of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in specific DNA repair pathways, replication machinery, and chromosome segregation produce genomic instability to drive multistep tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the principles and syndromes associated with inherited cancer susceptibility alleles and how these genetic defects influence tumor evolution and therapy resistance.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing framing for the lecture by offering reading recommendations and previewing the next topic.
